plugins.name: git-steward
plugins.description: Multi-repo git stewardship: branch pruning, commit & history hygiene, secret/large-file removal, repo health, work-item triage, and CI pipeline health — plus a fleet-wide CI watchdog that monitors every pipeline in every repo and autofixes failures (gated by default, autonomous per policy). Analyze (read-only) and apply (mutating) modes stack from a single operation to a single repo to the whole fleet.

plugins.name: ui-ux-studio
plugins.description: UI/UX design studio: a director skill that orchestrates real-world-inspired UI work — deciding when to design from rules, when to pull concrete references, and when the reference library is too thin and must be grown by discovering + extracting new sites. Bundles the ui-ux-references example library, a ui-ux-gallery skill to browse it in the browser, and composes with the ui-ux-pro-max rules skill.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: UI/UX design intelligence: styles, color palettes, font pairings, product-type guidance, UX guidelines, and charts across many stacks. Open-source skill by nextlevelbuilder, referenced here (not vendored) so it updates from upstream — bump the pinned sha to take a new release.

plugins.name: prospector
plugins.description: Lead-generation system for a web-redesign business: gather companies within a defined scope, store rich dossiers (sector, revenue, employees), capture + taste-audit their websites, score the money×bad-site×site-matters opportunity, deep-capture committed redesigns into a full blueprint (multi-page screenshots + code + issue register + implementation plan), and run an outreach workspace (agent-drafted email + copy-paste text → validate the contact → send). Runs locally as a dashboard over a filesystem store, or hosted in a container with shared-password auth; a headless claude agent-runner drains hunt/deep-dive/outreach/blueprint (cloud API), or a local Claude session can drain it off your subscription via the prospect-worker skill. Import/export the whole store as a bundle.

plugins.name: llm-mode
plugins.description: Working-discipline modes distilled from top Claude models, written down so any session can run them. Ships the fable-mode skill — Fable 5's five-gate task loop (scope, evidence, adversarial reasoning, verification, calibrated reporting) plus standing habits — to make planning, debugging, and review noticeably more rigorous on Opus 4.8 or Sonnet 5.

plugins.name: project-genesis
plugins.description: AI-native project bootstrapping: interview → foundation docs → minimal scaffold + CI. Generates a CLAUDE.md agent contract with a doc map and enforceable maintenance rules, plus lean product/architecture/decisions/conventions docs designed for future LLM sessions (current-state only, explicit non-goals and restrictions, read-before-touching pointers). Stack-agnostic — asks or detects the stack and adapts.

plugins.name: skill-smith
plugins.description: Meta-tooling for developing and refining Claude Code skills. Ships skill-retro: a session retrospective that reviews the skills and plugins used in the current session, grades their perceived performance with session evidence, appends findings to each skill's append-only FEEDBACK.md, and proposes concrete user-approved SKILL.md edits — the feedback loop that makes skills improve from real usage. Mostly user-triggered: 'skill retro', 'review this session', 'how did the skills perform'.

plugins.name: scroll-world
plugins.description: Build an immersive scroll-scrubbed 'fly through the world' landing page for any industry or brand using Higgsfield: cohesive isometric diorama scenes and seamless camera flights driven by scroll position (Apple-style scrubbing), with a portable framework-agnostic scrub engine for plain HTML, Next.js, Vue, or a Python-served page. Fork of oso95/scroll-world (MIT) vendored at upstream f941ef9 (v0.2.0) — see the plugin's VENDORED.md; local divergence expected.
